S.FORM: Shitan Shitan gu icuwa i Miaoli. ala atjunangn mapuljat 79.39 km² (ma'linpan atjunang 10.36 km², ma'linaule atjunang 2.57 km²). ala caucau mapuljat 387 caucau, ala daceneqlan mapuljat 156 a daceneqlan, Saysiyat (32%) a maqcuwa caucau. paiwan a maqcuwa caucau. a i vecekadan tua miauli king a shitangu. pasazaya tua samangu (samˊ vanˊ hiongˊ) a shitangu. pasakacedas a viri tua pinSa'o:ol; pasakacedas a navalj tua taian. kaljaqudjaljan a kadjunangan imaza a kemasi ta qiljasan a lima a patje qiljasan a siva. paljavak tua atjunang matja 7 qinaljan i Shitan. matja 1 qinaljan imaza, Sawi . cinalivatan kasicuayan a kaizuanan nia kacalisian imaza. qadjav a cavilj a 1900, djemaljun a ngaingai a papupaday imaza. tjaivililj, izuazua a ngaingai kata pairang uta imaza. izua milimilingan ta gadu a pasakaviri. pinapacunan a gadu azua a matu shize aya. shize aicu a anemanema qaca a qemuzimuzip se ciukuk. kinemenem a caucau imaza ta gadu kata puzaljuman tjaizua a kinazuganan nu vaik aicu a shize a kizaljum i puzaljuman. mavan shize a shitan aya imaza. kadjunangan a i vecekad aicu a shitan gu i tua miauli king. caucau izua 93.6% a caucau a tjatjuruvu imaza i shitan gu. papupaysu tataleman kasicuayan, pazangal a temalem ta paday kata ucia imaza. malialiaw a paday a tjaivililj, mavan putjavuvuk imaza. tatuluan izua tjelu a kedrikedri a gakku imaza i shitan gu. neka daigakku imaza. kakipucemelan iyubingkiuku (yuzeng) sasupuan na iyubingkiuku 354 a sasupuan na iyubingkiku se sawi' (shitan gu). remayurangan djalan na kasicuayan izua liaw a djalan na kasicuayan imaza i shitan. shitan a lizuk shitan a lizuk aicu a tjaizua a papatjezuan na sikamasantjelulj a palidring a djalan na taiwan kata sikamasan 124 a palidring a djalan na miaoli king. sipacacikeljan palidring a djalan sikamasantjelulj a palidring a djalan na taiwan: tjapazangal a palidring a djalan imaza. maqati kemasimaza a patje dahu gu kata sanwan gu. sikamasannemelj a palidring a djalan na taiwan: patje dahu gu kata lizuk a miaoli sikamasan 72 a palidirng a djalan na taiwan: nasinandjalananga aicu a tjadjaljav a kemasimaza i shitan gu a patje lizuk a miaoli. sikamasan 124 a palidring a djalan na miaoli king: kemasimaza a patje nanzhuang gu sikamasan 126 a palidirng a djalan na miaoli king: paka puzaljuman a mingde a patje lizuk a miaoli sikamasan 22 a palidring a djalan na miaolit:
